newsitem.title: GERMANY: Zeitler-reunification won't impact Bonn EMU chance.
newsitem.headline: Zeitler-reunification won't impact Bonn EMU chance.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Franz-Christoph Zeitler said on Tuesday that the costs associated with reunification would not impact Germany's chances of meeting Maastricht budgetary convergence criteria.
Zeitler, speaking at a news conference, declined to specify if Germany should be allowed to use this one-off cost as an excuse for failing to meet Maastricht budetary goals.
"Reunification does not change anything with regard to the prospects for (meeting) the budgetary criteria," Zeitler said.

States wishing to take part in Europe's monetary union are expected to hold their budget deficits at no more than three percent of gross domestic product (GDP) and their national debt at no more than 60 percent of GDP.
